name: The Lost Worlds
summary: Fragments of worlds adrift in storms.
description: A world from ARCHIVE: Worlds Within Worlds (chapter 7). It is drawn by the film's raymarching shader (worlds-within-worlds/src/worlds/70_lost.glsl). Opens the film studio at this chapter; a standalone interactive version is a planned adaptation (see docs/RECOMMENDATIONS.md).

status.notes: Viewable in the film studio; interactive adaptation planned.
